rows.title: Long Product Sync (2.5 mins)
rows.hypothesis: Haan toh basically kal ka jo project sync tha usmein humne thoda sa discuss kiya ki app ka current status kya hai aur next week tak hamein exactly kya complete karna hai. Abhi back end ka major part almost done hai. But transcription pipeline mein thoda latency issue aa raha hai. Kabhi kabhi audio upload karne ke baad transcript aane mein 30-40 seconds lag rahe hain. Which is okay for a prototype but production mein itna delay nahi hona chahiye Rohit ne bola ki woh aaj evening tak check karega ki processing ko background job mein shift kar sakte hain ya nahi agar woh possible hai toh user ko ek loading state dikha denge instead of making them wait on the same screen maine bola ki haan yeh better approach hai Front End Site pe Neha ko Summary aur Action Items ka UI Finalize karna hai abhi Cards thode Basic hain toh Ideally Summary ek Separate Section mein ho aur Action Items Checkbox ke sath dikhein Important yeh hai ki agar Action Item mein Deadline ya kisi person ka name mention ho toh woh bhi extract ho jaye For example Friday client email output owner amit task client email due date Friday Ek aur cheez. Hamein English ke liye testing aur karni padegi because kuch recordings mein English aur Hindi sentence ke beech mein switching kafi frequent hai. Maine do sample recordings already share kar di hain. But Priya ko aur at least 5 recordings collect karke deni hai preferably different accents or different speaking speeds ke saath marketing wala part abhi hold pe rakho because product flow stable hone ke baad high landing page copy finalize karna useful hoga so immediate priority back-end latency action item extraction aur front-end UI hai aaj ke end tak Rohit latency ka update dega Neha latest UI screen shot share karegi aur Priya testing ke liye additional recordings upload karegi meanwhile extraction prompt ko improve karunga aur specifically dates, names aur tasks ko structured format me nikalne ki koshish karunga. Aur haan kal subah 11 baje ek short 15 minute sync rakh lete hain usme bas blockers discuss karenge koi long meeting nahi agar sab green hai to directly implementation continue karenge
rows.title_out: Project Status and Next Steps Sync
rows.summary: The team reviewed the current app status, noting backend completion but addressing a latency issue in the transcription pipeline. Priorities include fixing backend latency, refining frontend UI for summaries and action items, and collecting more audio recordings for testing code-switched speech.

action_items.task: Check if audio processing can be shifted to a background job
Finalize the UI for summary and action items
Collect at least 5 additional recordings for testing with different accents and speeds
